mechanisms.name: Perp-hedged inventory during bridge settlement
mechanisms.origin: User-proposed candidate, pressure-tested rather than claimed novel
mechanisms.status: economically plausible risk reduction under conditions; identified historical counterfactual blocked
mechanisms.spread_cause_hypothesis: Fragmented inventories and settlement constraints create chain-local prices; urgently trading users may pay a local premium.
mechanisms.payer_and_repetition: Local takers can pay the spread, while the hedge transfers common price risk to perp counterparties. Repeated executable spreads net of competition, funding and fees have not been measured.
mechanisms.economic_asset_equivalence: Must establish exact underlying/index/multiplier and source/destination claim equivalence. A ticker match or correlated BTC/ETH/index hedge does not insure wrapped-token, FX, local-basis or bridge risk.
mechanisms.deployment_and_access: Observed current first-DEX Hyperliquid metadata and a current BTC book. Historical contract availability for the alleged sample is unknown; HIP-3 namespaces/settings differ. No order or signing tested.
mechanisms.inventory_credit_repayment_cycle: Acquire spot inventory, maintain a matched short over a predeclared exposure interval, settle/sell destination inventory, then close hedge and settle funding. If borrowed destination tokens already create the offsetting liability, do not add a duplicate short.
mechanisms.capital_and_costs: One total capital constraint includes spot funding, hedge margin/buffers, any loan collateral and reserves. Both perp fills, all route costs, discrete funding, conversions and liquidation/ADL must be included using historical settings.
cheap_falsifiers: The alleged 21-trade manifest cannot be identified.
The exact hedge contract was not tradable for the required size/time or has a materially different underlying.
Historical bid/ask/depth, bridge completion or margin path cannot be recovered.
Added hedge costs, adverse basis or margin failure eliminate the proposed improvement.
mechanisms.next_test: The finite input gate in counterfactual_input_gate.json, not a new framework or automatic backfill.

mechanisms.name: Recent native EURC unified-inventory rail changes capital reuse
mechanisms.origin: Fresh primary-source deployment lead discovered during assigned data-source review
mechanisms.status: Recent issuer announcement plus bounded account-state corroboration; no measured arbitrage spread
mechanisms.spread_cause_hypothesis: EURC liquidity and inventory may remain fragmented across supported chains. A unified deposited balance could reduce the cost of servicing urgent destination demand compared with separately funded inventories.
mechanisms.payer_and_repetition: Potential payer is an ordinary user valuing destination liquidity or speed. Whether any accessible spread remains after rail fees, settlement, FX, competition and capital costs is unknown.
mechanisms.economic_asset_equivalence: Gateway maintains separate asset balances and does not exchange EURC, USDC and cirBTC for each other. Verify issuer-native mint/contract identities and redemption terms; euro-denominated EURC is not a dollar claim at par.
mechanisms.deployment_and_access: Circle dated the Solana EURC Gateway pre-mint deployment 2026-10-23. The specified SPL account exists in a 2026-10-29 finalized RPC snapshot. Official overview documents EURC support and permissionless integration, but actual mint/deposit/redemption and legal eligibility were not tested.
mechanisms.inventory_credit_repayment_cycle: Deposits establish a unified per-asset balance; later destination availability consumes that established balance. New unfinalized source purchases are not free credit. Pre-mint inventory belongs to issuer infrastructure and cannot be appropriated or counted as entrant capital.
mechanisms.capital_and_costs: Requires real deposited capital and source finality, plus chain/rail/quote fees, FX/asset-basis risk, withdrawal delay, issuer/service dependencies and replenishment. No borrow or fee schedule inferred from fast-transfer marketing.
cheap_falsifiers: No size-aware same-claim destination premium remains after all costs and FX.
The entrant cannot access the relevant chain/asset flow under actual terms.
Incremental source deposits are not available in time to replenish the intended trade.
An apparent supply/price signal comes from issuer-only noncirculating pre-mint stock or stale accounting marks.
mechanisms.novelty: Newly documented rail expansion, not a claim of novel arbitrage
mechanisms.next_test: Eligibility, exact asset/route terms and contemporaneous size-aware quotes before any economic replay.
